_about: Routing decisions for records that are complete research but cannot take the INSERT route. Factual lifecycle status is preserved in every case; no status was altered to make do_add() accept a record.

pipeline_constraint.verdict: The guard is CORRECT and must not be relaxed.
evidence: Scholarship.status is documented in models.py as answering 'is this round open right now', and flips back to open when a new cycle is published.

public_visibility_conditions() gates the public directory, and routers/scholarships.py counts only status open / closing-soon / upcoming. A closed row is visible in total but in none of those buckets.

The pipeline already produces status='closed' itself: scholarzone_maintenance.py:989-1006 auto-archives any row whose deadline_date < today and sets status='closed', with the comment 'Status is derived from the same date, so leaving it open would make a filter on status contradict the archive.'
A sibling stage already reopens rows whose official facts report OPEN/UPCOMING (scholarzone_maintenance.py:2253-2256), which is the mechanism these recurring schemes should re-enter through.
pipeline_constraint.conclusion: closed is a real, supported, pipeline-produced state. Relaxing the guard would publish a stale cycle as live, which is the exact failure the auto-close stage prevents. The missing piece is not the guard, it is a route for a recurring scheme whose current cycle has passed.

decisions.award: Borse di studio offerte dal Governo italiano a studenti stranieri e italiani residenti all'estero (IRE)
decisions.cycle_evidence: The official MAECI page states applications for the 2026-2027 call must be submitted by 14:00 Italian time on 26 March 2026. That date has passed.
reasons: Current cycle is closed, so the INSERT route is unavailable by design.

SECOND, MORE SERIOUS: bachelor's eligibility was never confirmed from the official source. research_notes.degree_level_confirmed reads 'PARTIAL - assignment says 1st cycle/bachelor included; bando text still to be read'. programme_detail_official.degree_levels is an empty array, eligibility is an empty array, and benefits is empty. The 'Bachelor's' value in new_scholarship is an inference carried over from the assignment pool, not evidence from MAECI.
In a catalogue scoped to bachelor's awards, an unverified degree level is disqualifying on its own, independently of the closed cycle.
decisions.not_a_duplicate: Distinct from LIVE id 133 'Invest Your Talent in Italy (IYT)'. Different programme, different portal (Study in Italy vs the IYT portal), different legal basis (Legge 288/55 vs MAECI/ICE/Uni-Italia), different beneficiary population. They share only the sponsoring ministry and the esteri.it domain.
required_to_unblock: Read the official bando on studyinitaly.esteri.it/ListaBandi and confirm whether first-cycle (laurea) students are eligible.
If bachelor's eligibility is confirmed, route the record as HISTORICAL for the 2026-2027 cycle and re-evaluate when the next call opens.
Populate programme_detail_official.eligibility and benefits from the bando rather than leaving them empty.

decisions.award: Exemption from Tuition Fees for International Students under the Heidelberg University Charter of 28 July 2017
decisions.cycle_evidence: Standing scheme with two fixed annual deadlines, 15 January and 15 July. As of 2026-10-03 the 15 July 2026 window has passed and the next is 15 January 2027.
reasons: The programme has not ended. It is a standing, recurring scheme, so 'closed' means 'this cycle has passed', not 'discontinued'.
Degree level, eligibility and benefits are verified, so nothing blocks the record apart from the lifecycle state.
Correct handling is to hold it for the next cycle rather than to publish the closed one, and rather than to relabel it open.
decisions.not_a_duplicate: uni-heidelberg.de does not appear in the duplicate index.
required_to_unblock: No product change is strictly required: the record can simply be re-researched when the 15 January 2027 window is confirmed open.
The durable fix is a recurring-closed holding route in the ingestion stage so this class of record does not need re-research each cycle. That is a production change and was NOT made.

decisions.cycle_evidence: The official page states the 2026 award closed on 20 July 2026 and that the award cannot be deferred.
reasons: Single-award, single-cycle annual scholarship. The 2026 round is closed and explicitly cannot be carried forward.
Distinct from LIVE id 52 'Monash International Leadership Scholarship', which shares monash.edu but is a different award; the INSERT_NEW decision is recorded in REFRESH_OVERRIDES.json.
Degree level and benefits are verified; only the lifecycle state blocks it.
required_to_unblock: Re-research when the 2027 round opens, at which point status becomes open or upcoming and the INSERT route applies.
The durable fix is the same recurring-closed holding route. NOT made.

alternative_routes_considered.verdict: Partially true but incomplete as a description. It is the current state, but it conflates a deferred-but-valid record with an unverifiable one.
Correct for Heidelberg and K.C. Kuok. Not sufficient for MAECI, whose bachelor's eligibility is unverified, so MAECI is BLOCKED rather than HISTORICAL.

alternative_routes_considered.option: C. The pipeline condition is unnecessarily restrictive
alternative_routes_considered.verdict: Rejected. The condition is deliberate and correct. status='closed' is produced by the pipeline's own auto-close stage, and relaxing the guard would surface a past cycle in public listings that count only open, upcoming and closing-soon.
